verdict.rationale: The product is an Agent Skill run inside Claude or other skill-capable agents. You use it by asking in plain language: you request a logo, ask for changes, and ask for the kit, and the agent loads the skill from its description. Missing for 10: independent or third-party hands-on corroboration of the natural-language workflow beyond the vendor's own README and case study.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.
